name: GitHub
description: Read and discuss GitHub issues and pull requests, and commit and push the Bot's own orbit/<bot> branch from its workspace. Reads are automatic; comments, new issues, pull requests and pushes ask you first.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Read an issue with its latest comments

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Read a pull request and the files it changes

tools.name: comment_on_issue
tools.description: Comment on an issue or pull request (asks you)

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a pull request, by default from the Bot's branch (asks you)

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Commit on the Bot's own orbit/<bot> branch (hooks never run)

tools.name: git_push
tools.description: Push the Bot's own orbit/<bot> branch at the commit sha git_log shows (name both), never forced (asks you)

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: A GitHub token; needed for private repositories, comments, issues, pull requests and pushes.

settings.name: GITHUB_REPOSITORY
settings.description: The repository tools use when a call names none, as "owner/name".

settings.name: GIT_AUTHOR_NAME
settings.description: Author and committer name of the Bot's commits.

settings.name: GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL
settings.description: Author and committer email of the Bot's commits.
